title: Pairing scan messages
responsibility: Map known scan failures to readable notices and validate a phone display name.

inputs.name: scanFailure.cause
inputs.description: Unknown value to inspect for a recognized scan failure code.

inputs.name: scanNotice.cause
inputs.description: Failure to describe; unknown failures fall back to String(cause).

inputs.name: phoneName.value
inputs.description: Phone name to trim and validate.

outputs.name: scanFailures
outputs.description: Recognized camera, cancellation and pairing-offer failure codes.

outputs.name: nameNotice
outputs.description: Instruction to provide a phone name.

outputs.name: scanNotices
outputs.description: Readable notice for each recognized scan failure.

outputs.name: scanNotice
outputs.description: Known failure notice or string conversion of the unknown cause.

outputs.name: phoneName
outputs.description: Trimmed name when nonempty and at most 80 characters; otherwise null.
